exposure: Time period of ICU admission (1996-2003 vs 2011-2014)
cohort: The study included all women admitted to the ICU between the second trimester of pregnancy and 6 weeks postpartum.
finding: Peripartum ICU admissions are increasing, with women in the more recent period (2011-2014) being older and having more comorbidities, pre-existing conditions, and congenital heart disease, but shorter ICU stays compared to those admitted in an earlier period (1996-2003).
followup_time: 6 weeks postpartum (last observation of the peripartum period)
gest_age: 31.6 ± 6.2 weeks (mean gestational age at delivery for the cohort)
